name: 01-probe
eval: (function(){ var imgs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('img')).map(function(i){return i.src;}); var s=imgs.filter(function(x){return x.indexOf('data:image/svg')===0;})[0]||''; return JSON.stringify({count:imgs.length, lens:imgs.map(function(x){return x.length;}), svgLen:s.length, head:s.slice(0,50)}); })()

name: 02-xmlparse
eval: (function(){ var imgs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('img')).map(function(i){return i.src;}); var s=imgs.filter(function(x){return x.indexOf('data:image/svg')===0;})[0]||''; var com=s.indexOf(','); var svg=decodeURIComponent(s.slice(com+1)); var doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(svg,'image/svg+xml'); var err=doc.querySelector('parsererror'); return err ? ('XML-ERROR: '+err.textContent.slice(0,400)) : ('XML-OK root='+doc.documentElement.tagName+' children='+doc.documentElement.children.length); })()

name: 03-image-forced
eval: (function(){ var imgs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('img')); var im=imgs.filter(function(i){return i.src.indexOf('data:image/svg')===0;})[0]; return JSON.stringify({complete:im.complete, nw:im.naturalWidth, nh:im.naturalHeight, cls:im.className, id:im.id}); })()

name: 04-inject-test
eval: (function(){ var imgs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('img')); var s=imgs.filter(function(i){return i.src.indexOf('data:image/svg')===0;})[0].src; window.__probeResult='pending'; var im=new Image(); im.onload=function(){ window.__probeResult='DATAURI-OK '+im.naturalWidth+'x'+im.naturalHeight; }; im.onerror=function(){ window.__probeResult='DATAURI-FAIL'; }; im.src=s; return 'injected'; })()
